name: BLINKBIN
description: Ephemeral paste sharing with AES-256-GCM client-side encryption and burn-after-read semantics. Kafka-backed event streaming on a single EC2 t3.micro via Docker Compose. The server never sees plaintext. Architecture locked; Phase 0 implementation starting.

name: DRIFT
description: Chrome extension that detects when an LLM abandons a correct position under user pressure, with no new evidence introduced. Two-model stance extraction + shift validation pipeline. Works across any provider, local or cloud. Production-ready.

name: COMMITSENSE
description: Git commit quality analyzer running AST static analysis and LLM semantic validation on every push via GitHub webhooks. Surfaces regressions before merge. Still unreliable; needs significant rework before shipping.

name: ASTRARESEARCH
description: AI research agent pulling from arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar and CORE. BM25 + SentenceTransformers ranking pipeline returns top-10 papers. LangChain + MCP architecture. Early-stage prototype.

name: DEBATEITOUT
description: Multi-model debate system splitting AI agents into opposing sides with moderator control. Structured discourse around contested topics. Early design phase; implementation pending.

name: THATAIISSUS
description: Multi-agent imposter-style game: answer → discussion → vote → post-vote reflection. Agents compete to survive elimination while hiding their roles. Game loop and agent orchestration in design; implementation pending.

name: PORTFOLIO
description: Static portfolio with client-side HTML reconstruction from Markdown + JSON. Zero build step; runs entirely in the browser. Hosted on Cloudflare Pages with cdn.ianurag.site proxy. Live and maintained.
